pages.title: Block of Neutronium
pages.text: A cube of compacted neutronium, matter in which electrons and protons have been crushed together into neutrons. It is almost impossibly dense for its size, and dropping it on a floor would be a mistake. The surface is a smooth, dull grey.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Storing loose neutronium ingots wasted space, so I pressed nine together. The block holds its shape with nothing but the strong force, and it makes a convenient compact supply.

Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Compact Stars.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Bounce Core, Cosmic Neutronium Ingot, Degenerate Armour Plate, Dimensional Residue, Magnetar Shard, Neutron Star Forge, Neutronium Ingot, Proton Decay Residue and more.
